form:FormGroup.label: Node
form:FormGroup.helpText: The Stroom node that the volume belongs to. The node writes its index shards to this volume.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: The node writes its index shards to this volume.

form:FormGroup.label: Path
form:FormGroup.helpText: The directory where index shards are stored on the node. A relative path is resolved against the Stroom home directory. Example: /stroom/volumes/index1.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Relative paths are resolved against Stroom home.

form:FormGroup.label: State
form:FormGroup.helpText: Controls how the volume is used. Active: read and written. Inactive: read only, no new shards. Closed: data removed, not used.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Only Active volumes receive new shards.

form:FormGroup.label: Limit
form:FormGroup.helpText: The maximum amount of data to store on this volume, with an optional unit such as 500G or 2T (B, K, M, G, T, P; powers of 1024). Leave blank to fill the disk up to 99% or to 10 GiB free, whichever allows more.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Size with unit, e.g. 500G. Blank fills most of the disk.
